name: Japanese pitch accent
description: Colours words by pitch pattern (heiban, atamadaka, nakadaka, odaka) or shows the downstep, and draws a pitch graph in the term editor. Needs a pitch dictionary (such as Kanjium, imported in Dictionaries); nothing is bundled.
author: Alstroemeria contributors

display.title: In the text
display.description: colour the word by pattern, show the downstep number as a badge, or leave the text alone
